extracted.name: Chilled green soup with feta
extracted.description: Serve this chilled green soup as part of a summer menu. No cooking is required – simply whizz up the ingredients to make a refreshing, nutrient-packed meal
ingredient_lines: 1 large red chilli deseeded and finely chopped
2 large ripe avocados stoned and cubed
2 tbsp toasted mixed seeds to serve
instruction_lines: Put the feta in a bowl and pour over the olive oil, coriander seeds, chilli and lemon zest. Set aside.
Tip the remaining ingredients (except the seeds) into a food processor and blitz until smooth. Season. Add 50-100ml cold water and blitz again to loosen. Chill for up to 1 hr.
Pour into four bowls and top with the feta, marinating liquid and seeds.
